descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S20 「双击 Save & Extract，以及同一份记录粘贴两次」 Double tap on Save & Extract, and the same note pasted twice

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart.（UAT TC-13；TFA-92591 AC 1；TFA-92591 How it works 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient

When Paste the S02 note dated 'Oct 11' and double-click Save & Extract (one browser_click with doubleClick: true). Then paste the same note again with the same date and press Save & Extract

Then No duplicated chart rows: one chest X-ray row and one TTE row on Diagnostic Testing, the background not doubled, no duplicate issues, and no error left on screen

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Not judged until oracle.mjs has a count check or a post-run rounding:get read exists; presence checks alone cannot fail on a duplicate. Then: radiology has length 2 (one chest X-ray, one TTE); the background contains 'CKD stage 3' exactly once (admissionSummary.reason not repeated); importantPoints with source 'prior-note' are not duplicated; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S20 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
